verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a first-party Scheduled Messages API endpoint, which shows that scheduled emails exist and can be tracked through the API. The pack never shows how to set a future send time on the email send endpoint, and nothing documents cancelling or deleting a scheduled message before delivery. missing for 10: an explicit scheduling parameter on the send API, a documented cancel/delete endpoint for scheduled messages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out

citations.quote: Keep track of scheduled messages using MailerSend's Scheduled Messages API endpoint.
This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
